text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
They've entered the straight course!
Who is that closing in from the outside?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... amazing...
Wait, is that Tosen Jordan?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Whoa. What is up with those legs...?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan is the current leader!
Tosen Jordan pushes to the front!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Jordan...!
...Amazing... That was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Keep going. Just like that...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan holds on!
Tosen Jordan stays in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You can do it...! It's gonna be okay...!
Just go for it...!!

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
Run—!!!
JORDAAAAAN!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan crosses the finish line!
In first place is Tosen Jooooordan--!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: No way... You're kidding.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously?
I never saw that coming...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pfft... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Trainer!?
What!? You're being so annoying!?
choice_data_list: It was ridiculously amazing, like a dream...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Dummy.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"You're the one who built up this speed.
So get a grip on it already, would ya?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just about as fast as the strongest
Umamusume you've trained, I'd say.

text_block_list.name: Spectator E
text_block_list.text:
That was awesome---!
Tosen Jordan! You really got it, girl!

text_block_list.name: Spectator F
text_block_list.text:
That was insane fast! I totally got it on video!
Awesome!! That's gonna be tomorrow's front-page news for sure!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pfft... ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
More, more!
I can't hear enough voices or praise, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Gal Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Jordan, you're so cool!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah... Awesome.
This really gets me hyped...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, get over here too.
Make sure you listen closely.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...It feels so amazing.
The cheers for us, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right.
Do you have your smartphone on you?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, give it here.
Here.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Trainer, stay right in that spot.
Don't move, okay?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"I'm posting this video to UmaTok later.
So make sure you answer my questions properly, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...*ahem*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan pointed the camera
of the smartphone in her hand toward me.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-san.
Your trainee Umamusume won today's Tenno Sho (Autumn), but—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling right now?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh. Yeah, I know.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: And? Anything else?
choice_data_list: My Uma Musume is the strongest!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice.
Catch ya later then.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer is the strongest too.
...Whoops!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the winner's circle,
Tosen Jordan showed a bright, radiant smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What the newspapers and TV reported the next day—
...hardly needs to be said.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because Tosen Jordan had put on
a performance that truly warranted it.
